run_generate_inits: run the script to generate episode initializations for a Habitat rearrange dataset config
run_generate_inits_with_opts: run the script with extra config options to override dataset settings from the command line
review_generate_inits: review the generate_inits function that iterates over all episodes and resets the Habitat environment
summarize_generate_inits: summarize the generate_inits function which loads a config and resets the environment for each episode
test_generate_inits: test the generate_inits function by passing a valid config path and optional overrides
